method histogram(test: string) returns (result: map<string, int>)
    requires test != null
    ensures forall k: string :: (k in result.Keys() => k in test) // All keys are present in the input string
    ensures (result == map[string, int]()) || (exists maxCount: int :: maxCount in result.Values() && 
        forall k: string :: (k in result.Keys() => result[k] <= maxCount)) // All counts are less than or equal to maxCount
    ensures forall k1: string, k2: string :: (k1 in result.Keys() && k2 in result.Keys() && k1 != k2 => 
        result[k1] != result[k2] || result[k1] == result[k2]) // If two keys are present, their counts are either equal or distinct
```
